annotations: Four fresh traces plus original per author instruction; retain separate four-new sensitivity.
central_chain: Recalculate each of 14 glass-scan axis scales from measured pixel spans and new Metrosert dimensions, map rotations back to scanner axes, mean axis scales; transfer to measured paper dot pixels, refit photograph homography. Original datasets remain unchanged.
components: Metrosert standard uncertainty 0.0025 mm, common additive shift across 4 measured outer spans (correlation assumption).
Observed joint scatter of 14 scan-axis scales, used as transfer reproducibility component without division by sqrt(14).
Annotation sample covariance; divide by 5 only for the five-annotation mean, conditional independence assumption.
mapping: Spatial block deletion of target correspondences used as mapping sensitivity, not automatically promoted to calibrated uncertainty. Unmodelled correlated distortion and target-to-surface pose/plane differences remain limitations.
model: Retained transformer, RGB unchanged, update physical-scale channel only; local sensitivity with scanner-X/Y relative steps ±1% and ±0.5%, corrected synthetic calibration retained. Shared-scale derivative of prediction minus reference used.
scope: Conditional reference-uncertainty and model-scale sensitivity example. No total field-model uncertainty or real-domain coverage guarantee. No training, rotation, manuscript real-image table replacements or publication.
metrology_guidance: JCGM 100:2008 sections 4.2 and 5; sample covariance and correlated propagation; no quadrature addition of asymmetric model bounds.
